executive_summary: This chapter extends place-value concepts to decimal arithmetic (multiplication and division). Decimals represent decimal fractions with denominators 10, 100, 1000. The chapter teaches decimal multiplication by multiplying numbers as integers and placing the decimal point according to the sum of decimal places in the factors. For division, it presents methods including converting fractions to equivalent fractions with power-of-10 denominators, and shifting decimal points in both dividend and divisor. Practical unit conversions (cm to m, g to kg, ml to l) are thoroughly addressed.
key_takeaways: Decimal Fraction: A fraction whose denominator is a power of 10 (10, 100, 1000...).
Metric Conversion: Length: 1 km = 1000 m; 1 m = 100 cm; 1 cm = 10 mm
Metric Conversion: Mass & Volume: 1 kg = 1000 g; 1 g = 1000 mg; 1 L = 1000 mL
